name: Generate UV Atlas
explanation_long: Generates a unified UV atlas for the selected parts. Materials are replaced with a Default Material and an optional checker texture can be added. UVs are non-overlapping and global. Warning: This overrides existing UV sets and might therefore lead to issues with existing Texture Sets.
